answer: Weight follows one verified payroll slot. An employer attests the role, payroll publishes a hash of the pay record, and the bank confirms salary to its own account; one slot backs one identity, and a slot that stops paying loses weight. The record bridges employer, bank and key. Each fake costs at least 2,400 units in salary over 60 days plus 180 units in filing, earning nothing until then. A shell cheat starts from only an ember of paperwork, and its ground gives way like karst: duplicate accounts or one employer behind many slots are cross-checked, the slot revoked and its weight burned.
